facts.text: I have a dataset where Schedule is another time series inside SnapshotDate time series.
SO_CSD, SO_CRD, PO_CSD, and PO_CRD vary by SnapshotDate and Schedule (nested time series).
Product Category is a categorical variable.
I want to predict GR value for each Material using Temporal Fusion Transformer with pytorch_forecasting.
I want the prediction to use Material historical behavior by SnapshotDate trend.
The dataset includes columns Material, SnapshotDate, Schedule, SO_CSD, SO_CRD, PO_CSD, PO_CRD, Billing, Product Category, and Cumulative GR.
The dataset example uses SnapshotDate values 1/31/2022, 2/28/2022, and 3/31/2022.
The dataset example uses Schedule values M1, M2, M3, M4, M5, and M6.
The dataset example includes Material values A and B.
